# Ilja Safronovs

> R&D Engineer (3D reconstruction and computer vision: Gaussian splatting pipelines, benchmarking, continuous research) at Giraffe360, and Financial Engineering student at Riga Technical University, Riga, Latvia. The resume files below hold the full text. There is no separate llms-full.txt, because resume.md is already the full text.

## Portfolio

- [Portfolio](https://ilyaeis.github.io/): an interactive WebGL journey. It has no readable text for fetch tools. Use the resume files for the text.

## Apps

- [Sorting visualizer](https://ilyaeis.github.io/apps/sorting/): sort_visualization in the browser, 16 algorithms in five layouts. The algorithms are the original C++ compiled to WebAssembly; the drawing is a JavaScript port. In the journey it opens through a portal at the `sorting` stop.

## Journey (WebGL page)

Each link below opens the page and lands at that stop. Ids are stable names; the order is not part of the contract.

Universe `intro`:
- [Traits](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=traits): Creative. Adaptive. Curious.

Universe `work`:
- [Giraffe360](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=giraffe360): R&D engineer in 3D reconstruction and computer vision: 3DGS from sparse panorama views, benchmarking, research.

Universe `rnd` (Giraffe360 R&D, inside a Gaussian splat of a real apartment):
- [3DGS reconstruction pipeline](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=splatting): 3DGS reconstruction from sparse panorama views; influence accumulation, Analytic-Splatting, the pipeline restructuring.
- [Windows, outdoor views and mirrors](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=windows-mirrors): solved blurry windows, outdoor views and mirrors; exterior splats and orbital videos.
- [Benchmarking and evaluation](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=benchmarking): validation tools with ground-truth datasets, an experiment runner, artifact fixing on shared GPUs.
- [Meshes and viewers](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=mesh-generation): mesh generation, point-count reduction, an embeddable Rust/wgpu splat viewer and a comparison tool.
- [MCP server, mentoring, ideas](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=task-board-mcp): MCP server for the team task board; mentoring on a new depth algorithm; the looped drone video.
- [Tour narration](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=tour-narration): earlier (Jul - Oct 2025), a small LLM service that wrote tour narration.

Universe `education`:
- [Riga State Classical Gymnasium](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=rvkg): programming and mathematics track; state mathematics olympiads.
- [AI Talent Program](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=ai-talent): Ponder AI talent program.
- [Riga Technical University](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=rtu): Professional Bachelor in Financial Engineering.

Universe `projects`:
- [Flow](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=flow): offline workout tracker app (Dart/Flutter).
- [Graphing calculator](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=calculator): offline graphing calculator; 4th place in a programming competition.
- [Sorting visualizer](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=sorting): sorting algorithm visualizer (C++/SFML). Has a portal: the app at /apps/sorting/.
- Seen between stops, not navigable: `balancer` (load-balancing lab, before Flow), `monte-carlo` (Monte Carlo finance, between Flow and the calculator), `neat` (NEAT neuroevolution, between the calculator and the sorting visualizer).

Universe `contact`:
- [Contact](https://ilyaeis.github.io/?go=contact): email, LinkedIn and GitHub.

In a browser, `window.journey` (version 1) controls the page. All navigation calls return Promises.
- `listUniverses()`, `listStops()`, `getStop(id)` (with the panel text), `current()`
- `goTo(id, { mode: 'fly' | 'jump' })`, `next()`, `previous()`, `whenIdle()`, `resumeLinks()`
- `goTo` returns `{ ok: true, stop }` or `{ ok: false, reason }`. Reasons: `unknown-stop`, `not-navigable`, `travelling` (await `whenIdle()` and retry), `in-portal` (a project app is open; the visitor closes it), `exploring` (the visitor walks in the flat; they leave with Back to the journey).
- `listStops()` gives `app` (the standalone page) for stops with a portal. `current().phase` is `portal-in`, `dimension` or `portal-out` while an app opens, is open, or closes, and `explore` while the visitor walks in the flat.
- `?go=<id>` lands at a stop at once. Add `&mode=fly` to arrive by flight (needs a real browser).
- Browsers with WebMCP also expose the same as tools: `list_stops`, `get_current_stop`, `get_panel`, `go_to_stop`, `next_stop`, `previous_stop`, `get_resume_links`.
